mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP ( MVNO_ORD_NO, SEQ, OSST_ORD_NO, PRGR_STAT_CD, RSLT_CD, RSLT_MSG, RSLT_DT, NSTEP_GLOBAL_ID, PRDC_CHK_NOTI_MSG, IF_TYPE, REGST_DTTM ) VALUES ( LPAD(#{mvnoOrdNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 14, '0'), NVL((SELECT MAX(SEQ) + 1 FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = LPAD(#{mvnoOrdNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 14, '0')), 1), #{osstOrdNo}, #{prgrStatCd}, #{rsltCd}, #{rsltMsg}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{nstepGlobalId}, #{prdcChkNotiMsg}, 'WEB', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MVNO_ORD_NO , SEQ , OSST_ORD_NO , PRGR_STAT_CD , RSLT_CD , RSLT_MSG , RSLT_DT , NSTEP_GLOBAL_ID , PRDC_CHK_NOTI_MSG , IF_TYPE , REGST_DTTM FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = LPAD(#{resNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 14, '0') AND PRGR_STAT_CD = #{appEventCd} AND SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = LPAD(#{resNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 14, '0') AND PRGR_STAT_CD = #{appEventCd})

SELECT FATH_TRANSAC_ID , SEQ , SLS_CMPC_CD , RETV_CD_VAL , CUST_NM , CUST_IDFY_NO , ISS_DATE_VAL , DRIVE_LICNS_NO , IDCARD_PHOTO_IMG , IDCARD_COPIES_IMG , MBL_IDCARD_QR_IMG , IDCARD_CONF_WAY , DIST_RSRTN_YN , FATH_PROGR_STEP_CD , FATH_CMPLT_NTFY_DT , FATH_URL_RQT_DT , FATH_RESLT_CD , FATH_RESLT_SBST , FATH_RQTR_ID , SKIP_PSBL_YN FROM ( SELECT FATH_TRANSAC_ID , SEQ , SLS_CMPC_CD , RETV_CD_VAL , CUST_NM , CUST_IDFY_NO , ISS_DATE_VAL , DRIVE_LICNS_NO , IDCARD_PHOTO_IMG , IDCARD_COPIES_IMG , MBL_IDCARD_QR_IMG , IDCARD_CONF_WAY , DIST_RSRTN_YN , FATH_PROGR_STEP_CD , FATH_CMPLT_NTFY_DT , FATH_URL_RQT_DT , FATH_RESLT_CD , FATH_RESLT_SBST , FATH_RQTR_ID , SKIP_PSBL_YN FROM NMCP_FATH_RESLT_PUSH@DL_MCP WHERE FATH_TRANSAC_ID = #{transactionId} AND SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM NMCP_FATH_RESLT_PUSH@DL_MCP WHERE FATH_TRANSAC_ID = #{transactionId}) UNION ALL SELECT FATH_TRANSAC_ID , SEQ , SLS_CMPC_CD , RETV_CD_VAL , CUST_NM , CUST_IDFY_NO , ISS_DATE_VAL , DRIVE_LICNS_NO , IDCARD_PHOTO_IMG , IDCARD_COPIES_IMG , MBL_IDCARD_QR_IMG , IDCARD_CONF_WAY , DIST_RSRTN_YN , FATH_PROGR_STEP_CD , FATH_CMPLT_NTFY_DT , FATH_URL_RQT_DT , FATH_RESLT_CD , FATH_RESLT_SBST , FATH_RQTR_ID , SKIP_PSBL_YN FROM NMCP_FATH_RESLT_PUSH@DL_MCP WHERE FATH_TRANSAC_ID = '' AND SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM NMCP_FATH_RESLT_PUSH@DL_MCP WHERE FATH_TRANSAC_ID = '') )
